name: Necar Zadegan
bio:
Necar Zadegan (born June 20, 1982) is a German born Iranian-American actress and model. She made her Broadway debut alongside Robin Williams in the Pulitzer Prize–nominated production Bengal Tiger at the Baghdad Zoo in 2011. She is known for her role playing First Lady and later President Dalia Hassan on the eighth season of 24.
